builds.howItPlays: You fill the board with cheap units, and every unit you play gives one of your units +1 Might for the turn, so your attacks hit harder than they look. You hold back Inferna, a 2-cost unit you can drop into a fight at a battlefield where you already have units, and Thrill of the Hunt, which removes one of your units and replays it for free on any battlefield, to strike where your opponent thought they were safe.
builds.whyYou: You like moving fast and keeping the pressure on from the first turn instead of waiting for a big payoff later. Holding units back to spring a surprise attack and guessing right about where to strike next suits your instincts. If you would rather overwhelm someone with a wave of small threats than win with one big card, Rengar is your Legend.
builds.ratingNotes: Re-rated 2026-09-25 from three scored decks. Moved: Variance 5.5 to 3.5, because the deck plays full sets of units and runs no reveal or luck cards. Pace 8 to 7 and Stance 8.5 to 8, both small moves. The deckListUrl on file was the bare /decks page and now points to the display deck. Label unchanged. Scored decks: https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/df02f7a2-d27c-4075-9f6e-5419582e5135 (Barcelona RQ #6, DSG Prismaticism, also placed Singapore Best of and Ottawa Showdown 1st) Aggro 7/8/6/3.5; https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/7d4d21dd-4099-46ca-9fb2-38dfad736c1b (uch1haa13x) Aggro 7/8/6/3.5; https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/73580835-c6b6-412e-bd8b-75c20b30c688 (HeebieJeebie, Ambush the Meta, 43 likes) Aggro 7/7.5/6/4. tools.ts style: Aggro 7/8/6/3.5, mean of 3, labels Aggro x3. Adjustments, the same on every sheet: Stance +0.5 (the Legend pumps a unit every time you play one, so every unit is also a combat buff); Complexity +0.5 (the Legend's +1 Might needs a target on every unit played, often mid-combat through Ambush). Deciding cards: Pace, about 29-30 units with 9 costing 2 or less (Inferna, Irresistible Faefolk, Pit Rookie) and only 3-4 cards costing 5+. Stance, 27-30 pressure cards against 4-6 answers (Rampage, Sabotage). Complexity, 12-14 reactive cards (Inferna, Thrill of the Hunt, Grim Apothecary, Nidalee, Cat Form) plus setup units (Kinkou Initiate, Noxus Hopeful). Variance, 60-68% of cards as 3-ofs, with no luck or swing cards. Judgment and formula stayed within 1 on every Axis. Legend ability: when you play a unit, give a unit +1 Might this turn. Also played: https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/4b68127b-fd88-4d7c-947e-c737f2138090 (mom sky, Rengar Vendetta, a post-ban list in the same style, not scored because the slots were full). The picks found 15 decks from 15 authors in this style and no second live style. Confidence: high. Reviewer: riftbound.gg's guide (updated 2026-08-30) cites the Barcelona RQ top 8 but lists cards by set code, so I couldn't match it card for card. hextechanalytics features a 2026-09-13 Skirmish 2nd-place list and says the deck runs on Thrill of the Hunt replays, which agrees with this Build.
